title: Wilson family medical history
goal: A reader can trace three generations of the Wilson family, identify Emma as the index person, and associate each relative with the correct medical conditions and birth or death years.

rubric.must: Robert and Helen occupy the top generation row and connect as parents of David and Linda on the middle row; David and Susan connect as parents of Emma and James on the bottom row, with Linda clearly outside their parental union.
Heart disease, diabetes, depression, and asthma have four visibly different condition colors, and readable medical annotations or legend labels identify the conditions represented by those colors.

Robert is visibly associated with coronary artery disease and type 2 diabetes, Helen and Susan with major depressive disorder, David with type 2 diabetes, Linda with asthma, and Emma with major depressive disorder and asthma; James has no condition fill.
Robert's heart-disease and diabetes colors occupy separately visible halves of his square, and Emma's depression and asthma colors occupy separately visible halves of her circle.
Readable birth years appear with the correct names: Robert 1940, Helen 1943, David 1966, Linda 1969, Susan 1968, Emma 1994, and James 1997; Robert also has a readable death year of 2018.
Robert alone has a deceased X through his symbol and Emma alone has the double outline identifying the index person, with both people's condition fills and symbol shapes still distinguishable.
Every person's name and medical annotation is readable without overlapping another label, and condition fills remain inside their own symbols without obscuring partnership or descent lines.

ideal.notes: Three Wilson generations show Robert’s crossed, split-colour square and Emma’s split-colour index circle, with full fills for single diagnoses and a colour-keyed medical legend. Names, life dates, and haloed ages remain readable.
